title: Jeweled Gooey Ethiopian Tuna Shiro
description: A floral and gooey Ethiopian dish featuring tuna, perfect for a sick day, with a mother-sauce-base and vegan-friendly options, served in a shiro form and grilled in a binchotan-grill vessel.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the niter kibbeh or vegan alternative.
Add the flaked tuna and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a binchotan-grill vessel and grill over low heat for 10 minutes.
Serve the Jeweled Gooey Ethiopian Tuna Shiro hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
